name: lionfox_fixtl
description: Gets players through translocators. /fixtl checks you and the translocator you are standing in (the game's stone ones and Translocator Relocator's keyed ones), fixes what it safely can, says plainly what is wrong, and sends you through when it works. Also fixes a game bug where /gm left the server's noclip on, so translocators stopped noticing you. /fixtl check changes nothing; admins: /fixtl player, all, keys, reroll.
